{{Quote|Something to drink? The local liqueur is astonishingly good.|[[Pter Thanas]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]|<ref name="The Truce at Bakura">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>}}
'''Liqueur''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage, made through a process of distillation.<ref name="Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina">''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]''</ref> There were several types of liqueur available throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
